BiblicalUsage: Min is the word for a kind — the plants and animals God made to reproduce after their own kind, and the clean and unclean birds sorted by theirs. Creation does not blur its edges: each living thing bears seed within itself, after its kind, and the ark takes them in by the same rule, two of every sort.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the kinds tell us God loves order and fruitfulness together. He did not make a shapeless mass; He made families of living things, each able to go on being what He made it to be.
